links.effect: Reading level fell from university standard (11th-13th grade) to middle-school (5th-9th grade) (rank biserial correlation=0.83, p<0.001); 95% of patients with both reports reported understanding >50% vs 46% without the simplified report (rank biserial correlation=0.67, p<0.001)
links.tradeoff: Minimal hallucination rate of 1.7% in LLM-simplified reports; no hallucinations resulted in potential patient harm; all reports at least somewhat accurate
links.quote: Patients with both reports demonstrated a significantly greater comprehension level, with 95% reporting an understanding level greater than 50%, compared with 46% without the simplified report (rank biserial correlation = 0.67, p < 0.001).

design_hint: providing LLM-simplified report alongside formal report with radiologist accuracy review
